annotations.title: Indicative flood and cyclone damage to a building or asset

description:
Indicative damage to a building or asset at a place from river and coastal flooding and tropical cyclone wind: expected annual damage as a share of its value and in money, and the 50 to 500-year events, low, central and high; today, or RCP4.5 or RCP8.5 in 2050 and 2080 (wind to 2050).

Use for what flooding could cost a home, a property or loan collateral, and ESRS E1, IFRS S2, TCFD or EU Taxonomy screening. Give asset_value for money in its currency, which any one building needs; without it the money is for all buildings of its class in the point's 1 km cell, in euros, never one building's. A town or city asked by name resolves to one point of it: `built_ground` then says how its built ground shares out among the bands, which is the answer for the place; the money and band are the point's. Indicative, not a valuation: pass the caveats on.

asset_class.description: What the asset is: residential, commercial or industrial buildings, transport, roads or agriculture

asset_value.description: The asset's replacement value, to have the damage in money; without it a building's damage is priced at the replacement cost of its class's buildings in the point's 1 km cell, in euros

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of asset_value, echoed; nothing is converted

language.description: Language code for the name of the place found (resolved_from); the rest of the answer is English

place_name.description: A place name or street address; add the country after a comma when ambiguous (Portland, Maine)

protection_rp.description: The return period in years the site's flood defences hold; FLOPROS's when omitted

response_format.description: concise (default) answers the question; detailed adds every field the sources give

scenario.description: historical for today, or rcp4p5 or rcp8p5 with a year
